items.a: ZeroAPI generates complete backends from a conversation. You talk to Kia, our API architect: she asks questions, builds a structured spec live, then we generate the matching Hono.js code — routes, models, validations, Vitest tests, OpenAPI docs and a TypeScript SDK. The result is a complete project, ready to deploy or edit in your IDE.

items.q: Why a conversation rather than a single prompt?
items.a: A serious backend has details that matter: roles, relations, business rules, edge cases. Instead of guessing from a single sentence, Kia asks the right questions and refines the spec resource by resource — you watch it build as you answer. You can write in French, English or pidgin, and change the spec just by continuing to talk.

When you launch generation, we queue the job and free you up immediately. You can close your browser, drop your connection, go eat — the job keeps running server-side. When it's ready, you get a notification (email, web push, or Slack/Discord webhook) with a direct link to your API. Especially handy on slow or unstable connections.

items.q: What are the playground and marketplace for?
items.a: The playground is a built-in HTTP client: you test every endpoint of your API (params, body, headers, auth) right in the browser and see the response, status and latency. The marketplace lets you start from a template — official or community-made — instead of a blank page, and publish your own privately (your team) or publicly.

Several. ZeroAPI routes requests across Claude, Mistral and Gemini based on your plan, with automatic failover if a provider goes down. Free plans use Mistral and Gemini; premium Claude is reserved for Pro plans and above. You're never stuck on a single model.

items.q: Can I export and modify the generated code?
items.a: Yes, 100%. The code is yours — even on the free plan. You get a Git repo with a standard Hono.js project, no proprietary ZeroAPI dependency, plus the Dev Mode exports (OpenAPI, SDK, Postman, Prisma, ZIP). You can clone it, edit it, deploy it wherever you want. No vendor lock-in.

Every generated API includes: JWT and OAuth authentication, RBAC, rate limiting, Zod validation on all inputs, escaping against XSS and SQL injection, Helmet headers, configured CORS, and automatic tests. The spec goes through strict validation before generation. On paid plans, audit log and SSO are available.

Open community Discord for everyone, docs in French and English. Email support for Pro users (24 h) and a dedicated Slack channel for Business. The team is based in Dakar and Abidjan — we speak French, English, Wolof and Lingala.
Not yet — Orange Money, Wave, MTN MoMo and Moov Money integration is planned by the end of the quarter. In the meantime: bank card, Stripe, SEPA transfer and local CFA transfer (on request).
